item.name: noise-field
item.summary: background: WebGL2 domain-warped noise hero background (webgl2, client-only, reduced motion -> static poster, mobile -> tier 2 / tier 1 poster)

useWhen: Hero sections requiring a calm, generative ambient backdrop
Modern dark-theme landing pages needing tactile organic motion
Brand surfaces looking for rich visual texture without video overhead
avoidWhen: Dense reading passages or documentation tables where text contrast over the canvas has not been verified
Battery-saver mode or low-tier mobile devices where static poster is preferred
Pages already running a background canvas effect (one signature moment per viewport)

alternatives.name: mesh-gradient
alternatives.when: When soft blurred liquid color transitions are preferred over domain-warped noise

alternatives.name: particle-field
alternatives.when: When discrete starry or kinetic depth points are needed instead of a continuous field

tiers.0: CSS gradient poster only, no WebGL (server render, prefers-reduced-motion, Save-Data, no WebGL2, or frame-guard downgrade)
tiers.1: CSS gradient poster only (coarse pointer with low-end hints: deviceMemory <= 2 or <= 4 cores)
tiers.2: WebGL2 at DPR <= 1.5, 0.75 render scale, 2 octaves (coarse pointer without low-end hints, or fine pointer with low-end hints or viewport < 480px)
tiers.3: WebGL2 at DPR <= 2.0, full render scale, 4 octaves (fine pointer with hover, no low-end hints)

reducedMotion.description: Renders the static CSS gradient poster with no WebGL context and no animation frames. Under prefers-reduced-motion the runtime tier is 0, so WebGL does not start.

input.pointer: None; ambient animation. Optional `time` prop fixes the clock and `paused` freezes the loop.
input.touch: No touch listeners. Coarse pointers with low-end hints get the tier 1 poster; other coarse-pointer devices run WebGL at tier 2.
input.keyboard: None; the component has no interactive elements. Poster, scrim and canvas layers are aria-hidden; children keep their own semantics.

a11y.notes: The poster, scrim and canvas layers are aria-hidden; the root element and children are not. There is no built-in pause button: pause with the paused prop or the runtime pauseAll()/resumeAll(). The scrim lowers background luminance behind children but contrast is not computed; verify text contrast for your colours.

props.name: colors
props.effect: Three CSS colours: background, primary, accent. Resolved to RGB for the shader and used to build the CSS poster.

props.name: scale
props.effect: Domain frequency scale for the procedural noise octaves.

props.name: intensity
props.effect: Colour vibrancy and octave blending contrast.

props.name: scrim
props.effect: Renders a radial scrim of the first colour (25% centre to 80% edge opacity) over the canvas to lower background luminance behind children. Does not guarantee text contrast; verify for your colours.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Freezes this instance's animation loop. The global pauseAll() also stops it.

props.name: time
props.effect: Optional. No default. Overrides the internal clock with a fixed time value (deterministic screenshots and tests).

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier (0 to 3); the tier is the minimum of this and the runtime tier.

props.name: reducedMotion
props.effect: Optional. No default (follows prefers-reduced-motion). true forces the static poster. false only skips the prop-level check: under prefers-reduced-motion the runtime tier is still 0, so WebGL still does not start. Leave unset.

props.name: className
props.effect: Extra classes on the root div, appended after the built-in Tailwind utility classes.

props.name: style
props.effect: Optional. No default. Inline styles on the root div, merged after the built-in background colour (consumer wins).

props.name: ref
props.effect: Receives the root <div> that holds the poster and the canvas.

props.name: children
props.effect: Optional. No default. Content layered above the poster, canvas and scrim.

props.name: palette
props.effect: Colours from a palette (DESIGN.md A8): fire, ice, neon, mono, or custom (reads --fb-heat-0..4). Overrides colors; leave it out to keep the host's tokens.

mistakes: Keep the scrim on when placing text over the canvas, but do not assume it guarantees WCAG 4.5:1 contrast: it only lowers background luminance. Verify contrast for your colours and use host foreground tokens for text.
Do not set reducedMotion={false} to try to force WebGL; it does not override the user's preference (the runtime tier stays 0 under prefers-reduced-motion).
Do not combine multiple NoiseField components in the same viewport; follow the one signature moment principle.
The root element uses Tailwind utility classes (relative, w-full, h-full, min-h-[300px], overflow-hidden); install it in a Tailwind project.
Never call requestAnimationFrame directly to animate NoiseField props; let the runtime handle the loop.
verify: Confirm the static CSS gradient poster renders in server HTML before hydration (CLS <= 0.01).
Confirm that when prefers-reduced-motion is active, the static poster renders with zero WebGL contexts allocated and zero rAF cycles.
Confirm context lease is properly released when scrolled out of view.

notices: Includes 2D Simplex Noise from stegu/webgl-noise (MIT Copyright 2011 Ashima Arts, Stefan Gustavson).
